title: Ymir WordPress plugin builds WP-CLI commands with unescaped shell arguments
body: Bug (WordPress plugin): LambdaClient wraps the site URL, option values and image changes in hand-written single quotes, so a value containing a quote runs as shell.

Outcome: every value is passed as one POSIX-quoted shell argument (a single quote becomes '\'' and multibyte text is kept as is); a value with a null byte, and image changes that are not valid JSON, throw InvalidArgumentException before anything is invoked (the JSON message is: The given image "changes" must be valid JSON). Fix src/CloudProvider/Aws/LambdaClient.php and add tests in tests/Unit/CloudProvider/Aws/LambdaClientTest.php. The tests need a WordPress core checkout; the test command already sets WP_CORE_DIR to one.
